jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Asset Management
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Ventas is a leading S&P 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With an enterprise value exceeding $50 billion and a portfolio of more than 1,400 properties across North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas is a preeminent participant in the longevity economy. Its largest business is private-pay senior housing, which includes over 850 communities providing valuable care and services to more than 90,000 residents. The Ventas portfolio also includes outpatient medical buildings, research centers and healthcare facilities that attract strong institutional demand from the largest health systems, biomedical companies and universities and other research institutions in the world. Backed by strong financial performance and a collaborative culture, Ventas has the capital, capabilities and relationships to deliver superior value. The experienced Ventas team shares a commitment to each other and to the Company’s mission of helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives.

Asset Management at Ventas oversees performance and strategy across a diverse real estate portfolio spanning senior living, medical office and research assets. The team blends rigorous analytics, disciplined execution and deep operator and tenant engagement to drive NOI, enhance asset value and support long-term portfolio health. Asset Management partners closely with Investments, FP&A, Development, Legal, Finance and other functions to ensure alignment on priorities and to execute initiatives that strengthen both individual assets and the broader platform.

About the Role

The Financial Analyst, Asset Management supports portfolio performance through financial analysis, reporting and foundational operational insight. This role plays a key part in evaluating asset level financial performance, monitoring KPIs and assisting with the analytical work that underpins asset reviews. The Analyst helps ensure that asset managers have accurate and timely data to drive decisions and performance discussions.

This person also assists with budgeting, reforecasting, competitive analysis, capital planning and market research. The Analyst prepares materials for portfolio reviews and leadership updates, maintains key systems and supports cross-functional initiatives that reinforce asset performance. This position is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical skills with interest in real estate asset management. Key responsibilities include:
- Build and maintain models, reports and analytics supporting asset performance

- Review financial statements, operating data and KPIs submitted by operators or tenants

- Conduct competitive and market analyses to support strategy and decision-making

- Assist with budget cycles, reforecasts, capital plans and recurring performance evaluations

- Prepare reporting and presentation materials for asset managers and leadership

- Maintain accurate asset-level data and support system updates

- Support transitions, strategic evaluations and special projects as needed

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Accounting or related field

- 1+ years of experience in financial analysis, real estate or related analytical discipline

- Must be located in New York, NY surrounding area or willing to relocate for the duration of employment

- Willingness to adapt and thrive in a blended work environment with 3-days in office, seamlessly transitioning between remote work and in-office operations

- Strong Excel and financial analysis skills

- Strong communication, organization and time-management capabilities

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship now or in the future

The estimated base salary range for this position is $75,000-$100,000 per year. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary Ventas reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Actual base pay will be determined based on work location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and business needs.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other wellness benefits under applicable plan terms.

jobs.title: Manager, HR Systems
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Ventas is a leading S&P 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With an enterprise value exceeding $50 billion and a portfolio of more than 1,400 properties across North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas is a preeminent participant in the longevity economy. Its largest business is private-pay senior housing, which includes over 850 communities providing valuable care and services to more than 90,000 residents. The Ventas portfolio also includes outpatient medical buildings, research centers and healthcare facilities that attract strong institutional demand from the largest health systems, biomedical companies and universities and other research institutions in the world. Backed by strong financial performance and a collaborative culture, Ventas has the capital, capabilities and relationships to deliver superior value. The experienced Ventas team shares a commitment to each other and to the Company’s mission of helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives.

The Human Resources team serves as a foundational partner to the business, enabling Ventas employees to do their best work. The team focuses on building scalable processes and supporting leaders while ensuring employees have the tools, resources and experiences needed to succeed.

About the Role
The Manager, HR Systems is the sole internal owner of Workday at Ventas, responsible for the day-to-day management, configuration and optimization of the platform supporting the full employee lifecycle across Core HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Benefits, Payroll and Time Tracking. Operating with a product owner lens, this role manages intake, prioritization and execution of system enhancements, translating business needs into practical solutions and ensuring delivery in partnership with HR, Finance, Payroll and Information Technology.

The role balances hands-on system administration with accountability for Workday outcomes, including configuration, reporting, issue resolution and delivery coordination. The role partners with an AMS provider to support ongoing delivery while maintaining ownership of priorities and outcomes. Success in this role requires strong ownership, sound judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities while building credibility with stakeholders and driving consistent execution across internal teams and external partners. Key responsibilities include:

Workday Ownership & Backlog Management
- Manage Workday intake and prioritization, overseeing requests from submission through resolution

- Translate business needs into clear requirements and scalable Workday solutions

- Maintain visibility into priorities, tradeoffs and delivery timelines

Configuration & Functional Execution
- Configure and maintain Workday business processes, security and organizational structures

- Troubleshoot system issues and lead resolution for complex or high-impact items

- Support testing, validation and deployment of system updates and enhancements

AMS Vendor Management & Delivery
- Manage day-to-day execution of the Workday AMS partner, including intake, prioritization and follow-through

- Ensure clear ownership and consistent progress across all work

- Monitor delivery quality and timeliness, addressing gaps as needed

Data, Reporting & System Integrity
- Maintain accuracy and integrity of Workday data through audits, validation and issue resolution

- Develop and support reporting and dashboards for HR and business stakeholders

- Ensure system controls and documentation support audit and compliance requirements

Cross-Functional Support & Process Improvement
- Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, IT and Internal Audit to support ongoing system needs

- Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve system effectiveness

- Support execution of system enhancements and process improvements aligned to business priorities

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Management Information Systems or a related field required

- 5+ years of progressive HRIS experience with strong hands-on Workday configuration experience

- Deep experience with Workday HCM required, with the ability to support cross-functional HR domains (e.g., Payroll, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation) within a compliant, well-governed environment
- Strong knowledge of Workday business processes, security, reporting, and modules across the employee lifecycle required
- Workday Pro Security and HCM certifications preferred
- Experience serving as a primary system owner or product owner, with accountability for system enhancements, vendor delivery and overall outcomes

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and deliver practical solutions

- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate independently in a lean environment

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear guidance for business stakeholders

- Must be located in the Chicago, IL surrounding area or willing to relocate for the duration of employment

- Willingness to adapt and thrive in a blended work environment with 3-days in office, seamlessly transitioning between remote work and in-office operations

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship now or in the future

The estimated base salary range for this position is $130,000– $180,000 per year. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary Ventas reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Actual base pay will be determined based on work location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience and business needs.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off and other wellness benefits under applicable plan terms.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Senior Living Capex
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Ventas is a leading S&P 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With an enterprise value exceeding $50 billion and a portfolio of more than 1,400 properties across North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas is a preeminent participant in the longevity economy. Its largest business is private-pay senior housing, which includes over 850 communities providing valuable care and services to more than 90,000 residents. The Ventas portfolio also includes outpatient medical buildings, research centers and healthcare facilities that attract strong institutional demand from the largest health systems, biomedical companies and universities and other research institutions in the world. Backed by strong financial performance and a collaborative culture, Ventas has the capital, capabilities and relationships to deliver superior value. The experienced Ventas team shares a commitment to each other and to the Company’s mission of helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives.

The Senior Living CapEx team manages capital investment initiatives across Ventas' senior housing portfolio, helping ensure communities remain competitive, well-positioned, and responsive to resident needs. The team partners closely with operators, asset management, investments, and finance teams to evaluate opportunities, prioritize projects, and measure the impact of capital investments on property performance and long-term value creation. Through a combination of financial analysis, strategic planning, and project oversight, the team plays a key role in supporting the continued growth and success of Ventas' senior housing portfolio.

About the Role

The Financial Analyst, Senior Living Capex will have the opportunity to join an S&P 500 company and work on a high-profile and growing portfolio of senior housing assets with a focus on organic capital investments. The Financial Analyst will report to the Director, Senior Living Capex and oversee financial analysis, project underwriting, and portfolio-level tracking and reporting across 850+ senior housing communities in North America and the UK.  He/she will be a key contributor to an integral team within Ventas and will have a significant responsibility for, and impact on, the portfolio's financial performance. While we do not require any prior real estate or healthcare experience, we do require candidates who are analytical, detail-oriented, intellectually curious, fast learners and have a desire to be an integral part of a company whose track record speaks for itself. Key responsibilities include:
- Provide analytical support for a portfolio of senior housing assets located across North America and the UK

- Leverage property, market, and industry financial and demographic data to underwrite and make recommendations for capital investment feasibility and prioritization on project-by-project basis

- Create supporting materials, including the creation of presentations for project approval by company executives

- Track, forecast, and report project status, cash spend by project, variances to project budget, variances to underwriting on financial performance and returns on investment

- Collaborate with various Ventas internal teams and operating partners to help effectively manage up to ~$500M+ in annual organic capital investments across ~850+ senior housing communities

- Conduct occasional site visits to help evaluate potential projects and review ongoing or completed projects

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Mathematics or similar field

- 1+ years of post-undergraduate experience

- Must be located in the Chicago, IL or New York, NY surrounding area or willing to relocate for the duration of employment

- Willingness to adapt and thrive in a blended work environment with 3-days in office, seamlessly transitioning between remote work and in-office operations

- Strong proficiency in MS Excel and proficiency in MS PowerPoint required

- Experience using Power Query/Power BI, Python and other business intelligence and/or coding skills would be beneficial, but not required

- Working knowledge of finance and accounting concepts

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship now or in the future

The estimated base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $100,000 per year. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary Ventas reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Actual base pay will be determined based on work location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and business needs.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other wellness benefits under applicable plan terms.
